about.name: Tee Wenjie
about.title: Creative Full-Stack Technologist
about.tagline: Art x Code - I bridge the worlds of pixel and paper to bring unique experiences
about.description:
A Full-Stack Developer bridging the worlds of art and code.



Inspired by games and movies, I’ve always been curious about how things work beneath the surface. That curiosity first pulled me into the world of digital art, where I spent years crafting 3D assets for simulators and terrains.

Along the way, I realized what excites me most is where technology and art intertwines. Writing systems that bring an idea to life, sketching visuals that spark imagination, or experimenting with how design and technology can tell a story. All I see is part of the same creative playground.

Today, as a full-stack developer, I carry that same mindset: building experiences that carry a touch of craft and wonder.

experience.name: Terrain Engineer
experience.description: Specialise in creating and automating large scale detailed environments for simulators using 3Ds Max and Unity
